name: Designation Cases
query:
SELECT
    COALESCE(emp.designation, 'Not Set') AS designation,
    COUNT(dc.name) AS total_cases
FROM
    `tabDisciplinary Case` dc
LEFT JOIN
    `tabEmployee` emp
        ON emp.name = dc.employee_id      -- Correct join via Employee Id
WHERE
    dc.docstatus != 0                      -- Excluded Draft cases
GROUP BY
    emp.designation
ORDER BY
    emp.designation;
